components.description: Signature: one square-sourced trunk branching into share-sized, butt-capped outcome channels; failed is coral dashed; mouths filter Conversations.
components.css: :host{--ramp-0:#071722;--ramp-1:#0a1c28;--ramp-2:#0e2433;--ramp-3:#122c3c;--ramp-4:#16384a;--ramp-5:#1f4558;--ramp-6:#2d5a70;--ramp-7:#5f8796;--ramp-8:#93b4bd;--ramp-9:#b9d0d6;--ramp-10:#e8f2f4;--silt:#7fd1d9;--silt-deep:#4fa9b8;--silt-hover:#9adde3;--on-silt:#062029;--sage:#9fbfb1;--sage-deep:#6f9585;--coral:#e0786a;--coral-text:#f4a99d;--coral-ground:#2a2531;--coral-edge:#7a423f;--control-edge:#4a7686;--ease-out:cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);--font:'Atkinson Hyperlegible','Noto Sans','DejaVu Sans',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-delta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 170px;margin:0;font:0.8125rem/1.55 var(--font)}.ds-delta svg{width:100%;height:108px;overflow:visible}.ds-delta path{fill:none;stroke-linecap:butt}.ds-delta .t{fill:var(--silt)}.ds-delta .f{stroke:var(--coral);stroke-dasharray:2 7}.ds-delta ul{position:relative;height:108px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}.ds-delta li{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;transform:translateY(-50%)}.ds-delta button{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:baseline;width:100%;padding:2px 8px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:transparent;color:var(--ramp-9);font:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms var(--ease-out),color 160ms var(--ease-out)}.ds-delta button:hover,.ds-delta button:focus-visible{background:var(--ramp-3);color:var(--ramp-10)}.ds-delta b{min-width:2.2ch;font-size:0.9375rem;color:var(--ramp-10);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-align:right}.ds-delta .is-failed,.ds-delta .is-failed b{color:var(--coral-text)}

narrative.overview:
The dashboard is a Landsat false-colour delta seen from orbit. Deep slate water is the ground, silt-cyan and sage are the channels and banks that carry meaning, ice-white is the type, and coral is the one warm thing on screen: it appears only where something failed or needs the owner. Your voice is the river; the Overview shows where your words went as a delta of real outcomes, not as a grid of metric cards.

The window is opened, not watched, inside a 920×640 Qt WebEngine frame (720×520 minimum), offline, dark only. Density is calm and list-led: one sidebar, one column of content capped at 880px, hairline-divided rows that lift on hover. Organic curves exist only in data (the delta); everything else is rectilinear with soft 8px corners. One humanist face on a strict five-step ladder carries all hierarchy; weight and size do the work, never colour noise.

Depth is tonal, not cast. Surfaces step up the cold ramp (rail, ground, raised, control) and a single ambient shadow is reserved for the floating toast.
keyCharacteristics: One eleven-step cold tonal ramp supplies every neutral: grounds, hairlines, edges and all three text tiers.
Each outcome owns one colour everywhere it appears: delta channel, row mark, conversation entry.
Coral means failure or "needs you", and nothing else is warm except the amber warning tier.
1px hairlines inset to the text column, hidden beside a lifted row.
Atkinson Hyperlegible at 13 / 15 / 19 / 24 / 30, weights 400 and 700 only.
Motion is short (160–220ms) ease-out-expo state feedback; the delta draws once on load; reduced motion removes it.

rules.name: The One Ramp Rule
rules.body: Every neutral comes from ramp-0..10. The only off-ramp neutral is control-edge, which exists for a contrast floor. Do not introduce greys.

rules.name: The Reserved Coral Rule
rules.body: Coral and its text/ground/edge family appear only for failure or "needs you". A screen where nothing is wrong has no coral on it.

rules.name: The One Outcome, One Colour Rule
rules.body: An outcome's colour is the same in the delta channel, the legend mouth, the row mark and the conversation entry. Colour never carries an outcome alone: every mark sits beside its text label.

rules.name: The One Face, One Ladder Rule
rules.body: Only 13 / 15 / 19 / 24 / 30 (ratio about 1.25), only weights 400 and 700. A new size is a new step that must earn its place; do not add an intermediate.

rules.name: The Numbers Align Rule
rules.body: Counts at delta mouths use tabular numerals, right-aligned.

rules.name: The Lift, Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Hover and focus raise a row by tone (to ramp-3), never by a shadow. Hairlines beside a lifted row disappear.

rules.name: The Inset Hairline Rule
rules.body: List dividers are 1px ramp-5 lines drawn as a pseudo-element inset 8px on each side, absent on the first item and on either side of a hovered item. Section dividers (settings, disclosure, system list) are full-width 1px ramp-5 borders.

rules.name: The Curves Are Data Rule
rules.body: Curves appear only where they encode something. Chrome stays rectilinear.

dos: Do take every neutral from the ramp-0..10 tokens and use the role it is assigned (rail, ground, raised, control, hairline, edge, three text tiers).
Do give each outcome its one colour in the delta, row marks and conversation entries, always beside its text label.
Do keep coral for failure and "needs you", and pair every failure with its fix (a banner action, a fix hint, or a Switch model button).
Do show shortcuts as keycaps and destructive actions as quiet buttons that hide immediately and offer Undo.
Do separate list items with the 1px inset hairline and lift hovered rows to ramp-3.
Do keep type on the 13 / 15 / 19 / 24 / 30 ladder in Atkinson Hyperlegible 400/700, mono only for literal code.
Do keep transitions at 160–220ms on the ease-out-expo curve and honour reduced motion.
donts: Don't build a metric-card telemetry grid; outcomes are shown as the delta and as conversation rows.
Don't add cards, nested scroll wells, or shadows on resting surfaces; the toast is the only floating element.
Don't use curves in chrome; organic shapes belong to data.
Don't introduce greys, warm neutrals, or a second warm accent outside coral and amber.
Don't show a state the daemon has not confirmed; prefer an honest unknown.
Don't convey state or outcome by colour alone.
